newsitem.title: UK: Country Casuals halts Bunce offer talks.
newsitem.headline: Country Casuals halts Bunce offer talks.

text.p: British fashion retailer Country Casuals said on Tuesday it has ended talks with Mark Bunce concerning a possible offer for the group.
The company said that over recent weeks it has received informal approaches from third parties which may or may not lead to an offer.
On June 16, Country Casual rose on reports that Alexon Plc was poised to make a bid of more than 140 pence per share. On Monday, Country Casual's shares closed at 125 1/2 pence.
Country Casual has completed the disposal of its two loss-making businesses, Elvi and Lerose Manufacturing, to their respective management teams.
Its only trading operation is its Country Casuals retail business, which, for the year to January 25, reported an operating profit of 3.1 million stg on sales of 40.6 million stg.
